description: Reads a picture as a spectrogram and plays it — brightness across each row of pixels becomes the strength of the partials, low frequencies at the bottom

params.text: Bends how the pixels across a row are spread over the frequency range, 0.01 to 0.1, from bunched at the low end to spread evenly
Sets the output level, 0.1 to 10 times, and the output is taken through a saturating curve after it
Sets the pitch the picture is read at, -4V to +6V, a volt per octave
Sets which row of the picture is being read, the bottom of the picture at one end and the top at the other
Adds the red channel of the picture into the brightness that is read; the lamp is lit while it counts
Adds the green channel of the picture into the brightness that is read
Adds the blue channel of the picture into the brightness that is read
Adds the alpha channel of the picture into the brightness that is read

inputs.text: 0V to 10V moves the reading position across the whole picture, added to the POS knob
0V to 10V adds to the frequency curve across its whole range
Added to the pitch, a volt per octave
A trigger here turns the red channel on, and the next one turns it off
A trigger here turns the green channel on, and the next one turns it off
A trigger here turns the blue channel on, and the next one turns it off
A trigger here turns the alpha channel on, and the next one turns it off

outputs.text: The sound built from the row of pixels being read

notes: nothing sounds until a picture is loaded: choose Load image (png) from the right-click menu, or drop a picture onto the panel; png is the only format it reads
menu: Load image (png) — opens a png file and reads it as the spectrogram

inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
